## Scan {#sec-scan-documentation}

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
{{< skeleton-viz scan >}}
:::

### `Scan(UF)`
Creates a `Scan` instance with the supplied user function.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    auto scanSum = skepu::Scan(sum);
}
```


### `setScanMode(ScanMode)`
Sets the scan mode, the two options are `ScanMode::Inclusive` and `ScanMode::Exclusive`. The default is `ScanMode::Inclusive`.

```{.cpp .run}
#include <skepu>
#include <skepu-lib/io.hpp>

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    skepu::Vector<int> in{1, 1, 1, 1, 1}, out(in.size());

    auto vscan = skepu::Scan(sum);
    vscan.setScanMode(skepu::ScanMode::Inclusive);
    vscan(out, in);

    skepu::io::cout << out << "\n";

    vscan.setScanMode(skepu::ScanMode::Exclusive);
    vscan(out, in);

    skepu::io::cout << out << "\n";
}
```

```{.text .output}
Vector[5]: 1 2 3 4 5
Vector[5]: 0 1 2 3 4
```

### `setStartValue(T)`
Sets the start value that the scan will start on if running in `ScanMode::Exclusive`. By default it is set to `T{}`, the default initialization of the type.

```{.cpp .run}
#include <skepu>
#include <skepu-lib/io.hpp>

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    skepu::Vector<int> in{1, 1, 1, 1, 1}, out(in.size());

    auto vscan = skepu::Scan(sum);

    vscan.setScanMode(skepu::ScanMode::Exclusive);
    vscan.setStartValue(10);
    vscan(out, in);

    skepu::io::cout << out << "\n";
}
```

```{.text .output}
Vector[5]: 10 11 12 13 14
```
